title: Check if NetworkManager reports an active network connection
summary: Use `nm-online` to ask NetworkManager if the system is currently connected to a network. It returns immediately with a success or failure status, which is useful for scripts or quick checks.

steps.explain: Run `nm-online` to check if NetworkManager considers the network connection active. It exits with code 0 if connected, non-zero otherwise.
steps.expect: No output if connected; exit code 0. If not connected, it may print an error or exit non-zero.

alternatives.explain: Wait for a custom number of seconds for the network to become active.

placeholders.name: SECONDS
placeholders.description: Number of seconds to wait for connection
